title: Convert an acquired fixed-locality gap into finite rational equal-weight output
statement: AFTER a deterministic construction supplies fixed-(k,d) local positive contractions with certified polynomial-time entries and a true rational gap g=b-a>0, choose dyadic eta<=g/32 and ||R_i-h_i||<=eta. Then h_i_prime=(R_i+eta I)/(1+2eta) is an exact rational positive contraction with error e<=g/16. Dyadic zeta<=g/16, M=ceil(m/zeta), floor(Mp_i) copies and zero padding give -(e+zeta)I<=Hhat-H<=eI. Thresholds a+g/4,b-g/4 retain gap g/2 with M=O(m/g), without expanding common denominators. This converter does not create the missing gap.
